d: Long, flowing crimson hair extends from behind a pointed, helmet-like head. The eyes are narrow, glowing orange-yellow slits set within a pale, angular face. The build is slender and stylized, featuring a pale cream and deep burgundy exoskeleton-like body with orange runic markings on the chest. This creature wears an ornate, asymmetrical dark purple and burgundy cloak with sharp, architectural folds and holds a floating black and red orb. BODY COLOR: Pale cream and deep burgundy LEGS: Digitigrade with sharp, dark claws
